finalText:
**Green. 625 passing, 0 failing.**

Only 3 cases were red, all in `order totals`. `orderTotal` taxed the pre-discount amount. It took the discount off, then charged tax on `cents`, not on the discounted sum.

Fixed in [pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41). It now calls `applyTax(discounted, taxRate)`.

Most rows had a zero tax or a zero discount, so they hid the bug. No next step.
